options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. Id of the access group to query.

options.name: ids
options.description: Ids query parameter. Get access groups by passing a comma separated list of their ids.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Limit on the number of access groups on a page. Default page size is 20.

options.name: names
options.description: Names query parameter. Get access groups by passing comma separated list of names. It performs an exact character match.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. An integer representing the starting access group in the page returned.

options.name: sourceResourceIds
options.description: SourceResourceIds query parameter. Get access groups by passing the ids of the resource associated with it such as the site hierarchy id.

options.name: type
options.description: Type query parameter. Get access groups by passing the type of the resource such as site.

options.name: userCount
options.description: UserCount query parameter. If set to true, it will return number of users associated with each access group. Default is false.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
